chunks: Preferring patience in the absence of supporters

key_terms.الأَعْوَانِ: Helpers, supporters, or assistants (plural of عَوَان)
key_terms.الصَّبْرِ: Patience, perseverance, or steadfastness in the face of adversity

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of patience when lacking support in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In the context of the Shaqshaqiya sermon, this heading underscores Ali’s strategic patience during his prolonged period of political quietism (al-samt) following the Prophet's death, where he endured the loss of key allies and the shifting of caliphal authority. It reflects the Shia theological emphasis on enduring isolation and betrayal with dignified restraint until the rightful leadership is established, transforming personal loss into a spiritual trial of fidelity.
